markers.d: The train comes in from the east tunnel heading west and stops along the green side with its doors open for 7 seconds. Get on, or don't: the doors chime and close over 2 seconds, so you can still squeeze through (or get shut out) at the last moment.

The west loop itself takes about 13 seconds (about 20 from the doors closing to stopping on the exit side): a long, gentle loop under the city, past the old closed station. Whoever got on is shut in together. If It got on too, it's a chase through three cars; if not, it's a breather.

The same train comes back on the other side of the platform heading east. The doors open and everyone inside is pushed to the nearest door and out onto the platform (the pink arrows). Nobody can get on here.

4 deep: drop in to cut along the platform and jump back out anywhere. But if the train comes in while you're down there, or you're in front of it, you're dead. The edge lights flash 4 seconds before, and the boards count down.
A crawl space runs under each platform edge, 3 high. Crouch or slide into it and the train misses you.
An 18-stud gap in the green lane: too far to jump at a sprint. Wall-run along the hoarding or slide-jump it. Miss, and you're in the pit.
A scaffold shed over the pink lane, 4.2 high: slide or crouch under it, or go round the end of the works.
The same in the pink lane at the other end: wall-run or slide-jump it.
And a shed over the green lane: slide under.
Shutters half down on both sides: slide in one side and out the other to cut across the platform.
The middle of the platform: run rings round the kiosk and the columns, hurdle the benches.
While the train is in with its doors open it's a second lane: in one door, along the cars, out another.
Seats either side of a glass screen down the middle of the middle car: the one loop you can run on the moving train.
Past the ends of the platform the tunnel floor gives way. Falling in kills you.
